title: List of PhD placements
description: Great career prospects ahead! Discover what happens after the Master in Philosophy and the opportunies that are waiting for you.

blocks.html:
The MAP is designed to prepare its students for research and PhD applications. This focus is reflected in every aspect of the program, resulting in exceptionally high PhD placement rates.

Since the beginning of the MAP (a.y. 2017-18), 87% of the graduates interested in an academic career have continued with a funded PhD. This corresponds to 76% of the 70 MAP graduates.
